thesis: iShares Ethereum Trust ETF (NASDAQ: **ETHA**) is a passive Delaware statutory trust sponsored by iShares Delaware Trust Sponsor LLC (BlackRock affiliate). **[Fact]** The trust holds **ether and cash only** and seeks to reflect the price of ether **before** trust expenses and liabilities. **[Fact]** Shares trade on NASDAQ; authorized participants create and redeem **40,000-share baskets** against cash and ether via prime execution and custodial arrangements. **[Fact]** The trust seeded on **May 21, 2024** and began operations on **June 24, 2024** when seed proceeds purchased roughly **3,031 ether**. **[Fact]** At **March 31, 2026**, net asset value was **$6.38 billion** on **401.88 million** shares (about **$15.87** net asset value per share), down from **$10.30 billion** and **458.72 million** shares at **December 31, 2025**, after ether fell **29%** in the quarter and redemptions exceeded creations.
why_market_wrong: **Predictive attribute:** **wrapper tracking basis** (exchange-traded share price versus net asset value, fee drag, and after-hours ether moves versus NASDAQ session).
